nodes.name: Mechanical Exfoliation
nodes.procedure: Use adhesive tapes or PDMS to repeatedly peel bulk ReS2 crystals until greyish transparent few-layer or monolayer 2D ReS2 remains on tape.
nodes.source_text: The primary step of mechanical exfoliation is to use the tape to pick up part of the material crystals... until the tape shows a greyish color close to transparent

nodes.name: Sonication-assisted Exfoliation
nodes.procedure: Method 1 (Miao): Grind ReS2 powder then subject to 1h water bath sonication and 2h ice bath sonication, followed by separation, purification, and PVP encapsulation. Method 2 (Xu): Disperse 50 mg ReS2 powder in 500 mL ethanol/DI water mixture, sonicate 90 min at 500W using Qsonica Q700.
nodes.source_text: Miao et al. reported a method of sonication-assisted liquid exfoliation... 1h of water bath sonication and 2h of ice bath sonication... Xu et al. added 50 mg of ReS2 powder to 500 mL of a solvent consisting of different ratios of ethanol and deionized water... sonicated for 90 min... at 500W

nodes.name: Hydrothermal Synthesis on RGO
nodes.procedure: Grow 2D few-layer ReS2 nanosheets directly on reduced graphene oxide (RGO) by facile hydrothermal method.
nodes.source_text: Gao et al. grew 2D few-layer ReS2 nanosheets directly on reduced graphene oxide (RGO) by a facile hydrothermal method

nodes.name: Hydrothermal + Annealing
nodes.procedure: Dissolve ammonium perrhenate, thiourea, and tetraoctylammonium bromide (TOA) in deionized water. Grow black powder in reactor then transfer to argon atmosphere and anneal at 400°C for 1h to synthesize single-layer ultrasmall ReS2 nanoplates embedded in amorphous carbon.

unit_operations.name: Hydrothermal reaction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: dissolved ammonium perphenate, thiourea, and tetraoctylammonium bromide (TOA) in deionized water, and after growing a black powder in a reactor

unit_operations.name: Annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: transferring the powder to an argon atmosphere heated to 400°C for an annealing process for 1h

nodes.source_text: Aliaga et al. dissolved ammonium perphenate, thiourea, and tetraoctylammonium bromide... annealed at 400°C for 1h

nodes.name: Chemical Vapor Transport (CVT)
nodes.procedure: Thoroughly mix rhenium and sulfur powders, pack into clean dry quartz ampoule with iodine as transport agent. Evacuate to ~10^-5 Torr, seal. Place in furnace with source zone at 1393K, growth zone at 1343K. Hold until growth complete, slowly cool to room temperature, crush ampoule, extract ReS2 single crystals.
nodes.source_text: ReS2 single crystals were prepared using the chemical vapor transport method by Atriy et al... rhenium and sulfur powders were thoroughly mixed and packed into a clean and dry quartz ampoule with iodine... evacuated to approximately 10^-5 Torr... 1393K and... 1343K

nodes.name: Salt-assisted CVD on Diatomite Template
nodes.procedure: Thoroughly mix diatomite powder template with NaReO4 solution, dry at 150°C. Place in CVD furnace, expose to sulfur vapor in argon atmosphere at 400°C for 30 min to grow ReS2 nanosheets directly on template (no transfer needed).
nodes.source_text: thoroughly mixing the template diatomite powder with NaReO4 solution and then drying it at 150°C, and growing it by reacting with sulfur vapor in an argon atmosphere at 400°C for 30min
